title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: Elizabeth Bennet, quick-witted and quick to judge, meets the proud Mr Darcy at a country ball. Austen's comedy of manners follows how first impressions give way, slowly and with much sharp dialogue, to understanding.

title: Jane Eyre
author: Charlotte Brontë
description: An orphaned governess takes a post at Thornfield Hall and falls in love with its brooding master, Mr Rochester, before a secret hidden in the house forces her to choose between love and self-respect.

title: Wuthering Heights
author: Emily Brontë
description: On the Yorkshire moors, the foundling Heathcliff and Catherine Earnshaw form a bond so fierce that its betrayal echoes through two generations of two families.

title: Frankenstein
author: Mary Shelley
description: Victor Frankenstein gives life to a creature assembled from the dead, then abandons it. Shelley's novel asks what we owe to what we create, and is often called the first work of science fiction.

title: Dracula
author: Bram Stoker
description: Told through letters, diaries and newspaper cuttings, the story follows a young solicitor's visit to Transylvania and the Count who follows him back to England.

title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
author: Oscar Wilde
description: A beautiful young man wishes that his portrait would age in his place. As Dorian pursues every pleasure, the painting hidden in his attic records the cost.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: Nick Carraway, newly arrived on Long Island, is drawn into the glittering parties of his neighbour Jay Gatsby and the longing that drives them, in this portrait of the Jazz Age.

title: Crime and Punishment
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
description: A destitute former student in St Petersburg commits a murder he believes he can justify, then finds himself pursued by his own conscience and a patient detective.

title: Moby-Dick
author: Herman Melville
description: Ishmael signs on to the whaler Pequod, whose captain, Ahab, is bent on revenge against the white whale that took his leg. An adventure, an encyclopedia of the sea and a meditation on obsession.

title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
description: Alice follows a white rabbit down a hole into a world of shifting sizes, mad tea parties and a queen who settles everything by ordering heads off.
